paragraphs.source_en:
Like radiance from the cloud-surrounded moon.
 Prometheus, it is thine! depart not yet!
 Say not those smiles that we shall meet again
125 Within that bright pavilion which their beams
Shall build o’er the waste world? The dream is told.
 What shape is that between us? Its rude hair
Roughens the wind that lifts it, its regard
Is wild and quick, yet’tis a thing of air
130 For through its grey robe gleams the golden dew
Whose stars the noon has quenched not.

units.source_en: Like radiance from the cloud-surrounded moon.
